title: Hellenic & Balkan Energy Market Tracker - Input

dateFrom.title: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: First day to fetch. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, or the keywords 'today' / 'yesterday'. Defaults to yesterday.

dateTo.title: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Last day to fetch (inclusive). Defaults to dateFrom. Range is capped at 31 days.

includeAdmieData.title: Fetch ADMIE (IPTO) grid files & forecasts
includeAdmieData.description: Queries the ADMIE Operation & Market Files API (getOperationMarketFilewRange) for load, RES generation/forecast and balancing files.

admieCategories.title: ADMIE file categories
admieCategories.description: ADMIE FileCategory codes to request, e.g. RealTimeSCADASystemLoad, ISPDayAheadLoadForecast, ISPWeekAheadLoadForecast, DayAheadSystemMarginalPrice.

includeHEnExPrices.title: Fetch HEnEx day-ahead market results
includeHEnExPrices.description: Downloads the YYYYMMDD_EL-DAM_Results_EN xlsx package from enexgroup.gr and extracts hourly market clearing prices (MCP) and volumes.

includeEntsoeFlows.title: Fetch cross-border flows (ENTSO-E Transparency)
includeEntsoeFlows.description: Queries the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform REST API for physical flows on the GR borders (IT, BG, MK, AL, TR). Requires a free ENTSO-E security token.

entsoeApiKey.title: ENTSO-E security token (optional)
entsoeApiKey.description: Free API token from https://transparency.entsoe.eu/. Required only when includeEntsoeFlows is true.

alertWebhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL (optional)
alertWebhookUrl.description: HTTP endpoint (Slack/Discord/custom) that receives a JSON alert when a threshold is breached.

alertThresholds.title: Alert thresholds
alertThresholds.description: Trigger a webhook alert when curtailment MW exceeds maxCurtailmentMW, or MCP (EUR/MWh) falls below minMCPPrice (negative-price alert).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy for source requests (some operator portals rate-limit datacenter IPs).
